gameDescriptionHtml:
An open-world adventure RPG. Choose your favorite character, train your elite legion step by step, and crash all enemies on the battlefield. Strengthen yourself, establish a powerful family, create a great dynasty, and become the dominator of this fantasy world.

Embrace the call of destiny and embark on an epic journey!

Game Features

  • BUILD YOUR LEGIONS – A thousand soldiers are fighting on a battlefield with a classical top-down view. Deploy different soldiers, command squad attack in real-time, release skills, and use items. Use your tactic to influence the war!
  • RECRUIT DIVERSE HEROES – Over 50 characters for players to recruit, try to improve relationships and recruit them for your adventure. 8 classes combine with vast equipment builds, try to develop your favorite heroes by anyways.
  • DYNAMIC OPEN WORLD – Players can experience the customs of different races and civilizations on a vast map, meet partners with various abilities from the worldwide, take on diverse missions and adventures, and challenge powerful bosses everywhere!
  • CREATE YOUR LEGEND – After gaining territory, players can manage cities, build constructions, expand faction, and conquer the world. Face the crisis, create a legend!
